start: AI credits sheet; the server counts AI questions and charging is on

steps.action: Open AI credits and scroll to AI questions this month
user_sees: Rows 'You', 'Your staff', 'Members', each with a number
'Gym page visitors' only when there are some
must_not: Names of the members who asked

user_sees: 'AI questions from you and your staff' — 'Free'
must_not: A price here that differs from what the ledger really took

start: A gym whose server does not count AI questions, or with charging switched off

must_not: Words about questions costing credits while nothing is charged

steps.action: Close the sheet, ask the AI one question, open AI credits again
Have a member ask the AI in the app, open the sheet again
Open the sheet on the 1st of the next month
must_not: Last month's questions in the new month

start: Owner signed in; members and staff have asked the AI this month

user_sees: Totals only, by kind of asker

steps.action: As a member open the app; as staff open the panel
must_not: A member or staff seeing how much the gym's AI is used or what it costs
